The commission's PRCe360 cases for the three regulated utilities (PNM, Southwestern Public Service and El Paso Electric), each utility's own planning page, the US IRPs tab of the Update sheet, and a web search for a resource plan by every cooperative, municipal utility and agency that owns a plant in the export or buys from one. Cooperatives, Farmington, Los Alamos County and Tri-State do not file integrated resource plans with the commission under the same rule, so their plans are found on their own sites, in board packets, in the Colorado commission (Tri-State) or in local news.
